20: --- get a list of diseases on a target
21: local getTargetDiseases = function(self, target)
22: 	if not target then return end
23: 	local diseases = self.turn_procs.target_diseases and self.turn_procs.target_diseases[target.uid]
24: 	if diseases then return diseases end
25: 
26: 	local num, dur = 0, 0
27: 	diseases = {}
28: 	for eff_id, p in pairs(target.tmp) do
29: 		local e = target.tempeffect_def[eff_id]
30: 		if e.subtype.disease then
31: 			num, dur = num + 1, dur + p.dur
32: 			diseases[#diseases+1] = {id=eff_id, params=p}
33: 		end
34: 	end
35: 	diseases.num, diseases.dur = num, dur
36: 	self.turn_procs.target_diseases = self.turn_procs.target_diseases or {}
37: 	self.turn_procs.target_diseases[target.uid] = diseases
38: 	return diseases
39: end

translation_snapshot.source:
Make your target's diseases burst, doing %0.2f blight damage for each disease it is infected with.
		This will also spread any diseases to any nearby foes in a radius of %d with a minimum duration of 6.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
使目标的疾病爆发，每种疾病造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		同时会将目标身上的所有疾病传播给 %d 码半径内的附近敌人，疾病的持续时间最少为 6 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: Time and Space seem to warp and bend around the massive tip of this stave.
translation_snapshot.target: 法杖粗大的尖端周围，时空似乎发生了扭曲。
